cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our school trip now needs two signatures on every consent form. Reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Good. Independent eyes before any child boards a bus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. We've found a safeguard our second safeguard needed. Who's checking that third person?

mechanism: Copy an organizer's highlighting as a new universal approval requirement, then call each resulting wait a safeguard.
confusable: Not ordinary checking: B2 must show that A copied a mark intended only for illegible signatures.
comparison: School transport timing and teacher availability differ from a ceremonial opening.
seedUse: Uses consent signatures, June and boarding from the canonical Drive; changes the specific complication to June supervising children.
